events.voiceover_text: If short video reaches almost everyone online, AI video tooling needs proof trails, not just faster editing.
events.visual_action: Large conflict subtitle with a quick source teaser card; no external footage.
events.zoom_or_highlight: No zoom yet; prepare viewer for official evidence.
events.privacy_action: No people, accounts, comments, QR codes, or public-video UI shown.
events.voiceover_density: high: one concise hook sentence in 3 seconds
events.comfort_note: Avoid unsupported claims; frame as a question/why-now hook.

events.voiceover_text: First, show the official report page before interpreting the number.
events.visual_action: Wide PDF screenshot with source label and quick line-box hint.
events.zoom_or_highlight: Fast initial highlight around the target line; keep the page frame visible.
events.privacy_action: No masking needed; official report fixture contains no personal identifiers.
events.voiceover_density: medium: introduce source provenance, not full interpretation
events.comfort_note: Hold long enough for viewers to recognize this is an official source.

events.voiceover_text: Now zoom to the exact line: the statistic is the claim-bearing evidence, not decoration.
events.visual_action: Dynamic push-in to the PDF bbox, then locked hold.
events.zoom_or_highlight: zoom_to_pdf_line_and_highlight; underline and line-box synchronized to narration.
events.privacy_action: No masking needed for this official PDF fixture.
events.voiceover_density: medium-low: leave reading space during the zoom hold
events.comfort_note: Do not move camera while the text is too small; let the highlighted line breathe.

events.voiceover_text: Then add a second context source or chart to explain why source tracking matters for AI video workflows.
events.visual_action: Split-screen source/context card or chart placeholder; no public-video insert in this fixture.
events.zoom_or_highlight: Gentle Ken Burns-style push on context image; highlight only the relevant label.
events.privacy_action: If a future public-video window is inserted here, mask faces, accounts, comments, QR codes, logos, and sensitive subtitles before render.
events.voiceover_density: medium: one supporting idea plus one caveat
events.comfort_note: Use context as support, not a second unsupported claim.

events.voiceover_text: The conclusion must return to the evidence: automation is useful only if the source trail stays reviewable.
events.visual_action: Return to source label and manifest path; show compact evidence chain.
events.zoom_or_highlight: No new zoom; use subtle source-path highlight and cue-to-evidence labels.
events.privacy_action: No public-video or personal data included.
events.voiceover_density: medium: synthesis with explicit source callback
events.comfort_note: Avoid overclaiming beyond the report statistic and workflow implication.

events.voiceover_text: Before publishing, review the source manifest, privacy check, and sync timeline.
events.visual_action: Review gate card listing source_manifest, privacy_check, sync_timeline, and render_report.
events.zoom_or_highlight: Static checklist highlight; no camera motion.
events.privacy_action: Confirm no secrets, cookies, raw public-video originals, or unclear-rights media are present.
events.comfort_note: End with review/verification, not an auto-publish call to action.
